newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends unchanged in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends unchanged in listless trade.

text.p: * Central Bank keeps peso in a range
The Philippine peso ended unchanged at 26.284 pesos on Wednesday in listless trading on a dearth of market-moving developments, traders said.
The day's average was at 26.285 pesos from 26.284, with turnover rising to $135.38 million from $95.50 million.
"Nothing much happened. Banks were just turning their dollars around," said a dealer from a large bank.
The Central Bank, however, was a net seller of dollars.
"There was good corporate demand for dollars but inflows were not that much," said the same trader.
The Central Bank just kept the market within a range selling about $49 million at 26.285 and buying $14 million at 26.284, another trader said.
Looking ahead, the market is likely to take a cue from the Central Bank which had been trending the peso towards a gradual depreciation in the past few weeks, traders said.
The move is intended to curb the country's widening trade deficit, analysts said.
